core_obligations: Retain the full per-party incoming/outgoing noise budget and fixed broadcast protocol model.

difficulty_reason: The authors combine local repetition-based message estimates with global error-corrected rebroadcasts and a final majority. The proof separates two ways a final output can fail and charges each to a different per-party adversarial budget. This is a nonroutine interactive-coding construction.
